payloads.name: CheatRunner
payloads.description: Web-based PS5 cheat trainer for already-jailbroken PS5 consoles.

payloads.name: Pegasus DL
payloads.description: PS5 payload for direct package downloading and local file management through a web interface.

payloads.name: Kylin Core
payloads.description: PS5 homebrew cheat loader and real-time game modifier.

payloads.name: Ghostpad
payloads.description: PS5 virtual DualSense payload for remote controller input over LAN, used with the Ghostpad PC app.

payloads.name: Kura Loader
payloads.description: Self-contained PS5 companion payload for Kura with a web dashboard, installs, cheats, saves, storage tools and console management.

payloads.name: SVT Play Installer
payloads.description: Installs the unofficial SVT Play 10-foot UI to the PS5 Media tab; streams are generally geo-restricted to Swedish IP addresses.

payloads.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Info
payloads.description: Parses PS5 Backup and Restore archive information and logs results locally and remotely.

payloads.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Main Segments
payloads.description: Parses a PS5 Backup and Restore archive and dumps special/main embedded segments.

payloads.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Full Dump
payloads.description: Dumps supported embedded files from a PS5 Backup and Restore archive to USB.

payloads.name: PS5 BAR Tool - Save Data
payloads.description: Parses PS5 Backup and Restore archives and dumps PS4/PS5 save-data files.

payloads.name: Ghostcontrol
payloads.description: Uses supported third-party USB controllers on PS5 by translating USB HID input into a virtual DualSense.

payloads.name: RESTORE_PM
payloads.description: Restores the Payload Manager tile on the PS5 home screen if it is missing or no longer opens.

payloads.name: ProsperoPlayer
payloads.description: PS5 homebrew media player for USB video, music and images with subtitles, resume playback and media controls.
